osm_bbox.description: Bounding box for loading OpenStreetMap data in format MINLAT,MINLON,MAXLAT,MAXLON. Corresponds to the -o/--osm option.

s3d_url.description: URL to skip S3D environment detection and connect directly. Corresponds to the --s3d-url option.

input_files.description: List of input files to process. Corresponds to the [files] positional argument.
